state.request: Replace named Empirical workstreams with one active feature per Git worktree. Remove all workstream CLI flags, commands, MCP tools, manifests, types, storage, generated guidance, and documentation without named-workstream compatibility. Move revisions and events into feature-scoped state so parallel branches merge without shared state/event collisions, use descriptive feature slugs, and safely migrate existing default root state. Add an interactive first-run init/config wizard with persisted ask-or-off isolation, editable detected base branch, sibling ../<repo>-<feature> path, <type>/<feature> branch naming, required Complex decision records, and non-interactive flags/defaults. When unrelated work starts in an active clean checkout, preview and ask approval before executing git worktree add -b <type>/<feature> ../<repo>-<feature> <detected-base>; block dirty trees, unresolved bases, and collisions, never force, and support structured agent/MCP approval handoff. Add evidence-backed .empirical/specs/<feature>/decisions.md, enforce it at Complex Design and Review, and add empirical explain with current state, next-step reason, missing context, gate, decisions, and JSON output without storing private chain-of-thought. Exclude automatic stash/move/delete, agent launches, and enterprise Jira/ADR/wiki ceremony. Reset the alpha package version to 0.20.0, fully verify and publish it, then permanently unpublish npm versions 2.0.0, 2.2.0, 2.3.0, and 2.3.1 after explicit registry authentication.
